step: B-S12 (R-3, LAW §9, B0): every directory walk and computed-path read in tests/, tests-visual/ and scripts/ goes onto F-1's file set. Two readers, one rule each: tests/harness/source.ts reads source (F-1's file set; a path the set does not hold fails the read), and tests/harness/artifacts.ts reads everything that is not source (a build output, a run's output, a path outside the repository) and refuses a code file in a zone, so a non-source read can never hide a reference into the tree. A script that reads source reads the floor door's openTree (the same file set). F-1 itself is corrected where it counted a write as a read. Dead readers are deleted, not converted
